status: researcher proposal; no purchase or treatment plan
denominator: at least one human in the household during a disruption, conceptually; numerical probability unavailable
clinical_expertise: doctors available per user; medicines/equipment/transport may be constrained

bands.A: More likely routine problems over a 90-day disruption
bands.B: Plausible illnesses and complications; likelihood rises with particular failures
bands.C: Generally less frequent serious complications and unrelated acute illness
bands.D: Exposure-dependent emergencies — these can move to the top

newborn_postpartum_overlays.problem: Feeding/latch problems, insufficient intake, dehydration and low blood glucose
newborn_postpartum_overlays.likelihood_and_urgency: Feeding difficulty is a plausible early issue; serious inadequate intake can progress quickly

newborn_postpartum_overlays.problem: Jaundice, excessive weight loss and missed early follow-up
newborn_postpartum_overlays.likelihood_and_urgency: Physiologic jaundice and dangerous jaundice must be distinguished; household probabilities not estimated
Lower-frequency but critical; fever or poor feeding may be the first sign

newborn_postpartum_overlays.problem: Breathing difficulty/apnea, temperature instability and unsafe-sleep suffocation risk
newborn_postpartum_overlays.likelihood_and_urgency: Exposure/illness dependent; urgent and distinct from adult symptom management

newborn_postpartum_overlays.problem: Interrupted feeding support, routine newborn care or access to neonatal treatment
newborn_postpartum_overlays.likelihood_and_urgency: Care disruption raises consequences of otherwise manageable problems

newborn_postpartum_overlays.problem: Pain, constipation, hemorrhoids and ordinary recovery needs
newborn_postpartum_overlays.likelihood_and_urgency: Common recovery needs; distinguish normal recovery from complications

newborn_postpartum_overlays.problem: Nipple pain, engorgement, mastitis or breast abscess
newborn_postpartum_overlays.likelihood_and_urgency: Plausible; worsening infection can need systemic treatment

newborn_postpartum_overlays.problem: Perineal/cesarean wound infection or uterine infection
newborn_postpartum_overlays.likelihood_and_urgency: Plausible to serious; disrupted washing and follow-up add vulnerability

newborn_postpartum_overlays.problem: Postpartum hemorrhage, pre-eclampsia or a blood clot/pulmonary embolism
newborn_postpartum_overlays.likelihood_and_urgency: Less frequent but potentially fatal; trauma bandages do not cover these mechanisms
Depression and psychosis have different likelihoods and urgency; do not conflate them

limitations: No matched 90-day San Jose household incidence dataset found in this bounded source set.
Exact ordering within bands is not established.
Generic disaster clinic samples are selected; short historical outages do not model 90 days.
Some specific diagnosis examples are clinical completeness prompts, not independently verified incidence claims.
No doctor availability implies hospital, cold-chain, oxygen, laboratory or surgical capability.
next_phase: Map prevention, recognition, treatment options, medicines, non-drug equipment, dependencies and shortage consequences per risk; assign procurement priorities afterwards.
